requirements.shall: Keep one original selling account, one event, one host and at most one contributing guest; guest participation never changes seller-of-record, inventory, auction or order ownership.
Gate the feature off by default; disabled or ineligible users/events must neither expose the entry nor initialize VDO.Ninja, camera/mic or a publisher.

Authorize host bootstrap, invite creation, studio commands and publish-session acquisition at a trusted boundary; reject unauthorized, cross-event and ended/cancelled-event access. UI hiding is insufficient.
Add a compact co-host entry and session status while keeping existing listing management, public chat and stream operations usable and visible.

Maintain a single media owner and at most one outgoing program publisher per event/session; repeated launch and duplicate windows focus or attach to that owner instead of acquiring another camera or publisher.
Never acquire devices, create a peer connection or publish during SSR/module evaluation/page load; host and guest capture begins only after their explicit user action.
Issue a guest-only, event/session-bound invitation through the trusted control service; neither the invite nor guest bootstrap may contain host privileges or event ingest credentials.

Make invites expire within 900 seconds before redemption, redeem atomically for one guest lease, support revocation/rotation, and reject expired, revoked or already-redeemed copies; an existing lease uses separate bounded renewal.
Reject a second guest without disturbing the first; replacing a guest requires host removal/revocation first and invalidates the old connection generation.
Show event/host identity and a clear explanation of backstage versus on-air; the guest must explicitly opt into setup/join and can decline or leave.
Check camera, microphone and live transport readiness; report Ready only after actual usable tracks and transport readiness, not merely iframe load or permission-granted state.

Handle permission denial/dismissal, absent/busy devices, insecure/blocked embeds and failed transport with actionable retry/direct-open guidance; failed attempts must not leak tracks or falsely report Ready.
Keep a joining/rejoining guest outside the public video AND public audio until explicit host admission; allow host preview and conversation independently of the program.
Provide private host/guest text messaging labeled private; do not forward it to public buyer chat or program overlays. Private spoken host cues are not a baseline feature.

Require output publishing before admission; apply session/generation validation and a program revision acknowledgement; stale or duplicate admission must not resurrect a removed/replaced guest. Guest UI may say On air only after that acknowledgement.
Provide Stacked, Side by side and Picture in picture layouts in one fixed 720x1280 program at a 30 fps target; layout changes must not recapture devices or restart the publisher.

Provide guest self camera/mic controls, host program mute/camera exclusion and removal; show a camera-off placeholder, keep permissions/consent intact, and do not remotely force a physically muted guest to capture.
Provide conversational return excluding each participant own mic and delayed buyer playback; prevent duplicate host mic capture, duplicate audio playback and doubled program audio.

Build a separate outgoing audio bus containing host mic and only the admitted/unmuted guest; camera/video gating alone is not sufficient. Exclude private text/notification audio and delayed public-player return.

On host removal, exclude guest video/audio at program ingress within 1000 ms, invalidate its admission/lease, and return to a host-only program without restarting output; account for downstream viewer delay separately.
Guest leave stops guest capture/contribution and removes it from the public program; clearly offer return to viewing without granting seller controls.
Do not grant a guest listing, chat-moderation, seller-account, start/end-event or publishing authority; media-room/director roles must not be treated as platform permissions.
Label local program preview separately from delayed audience playback, and keep audience playback muted/disconnected from the conversation audio path.

Publish the custom canvas video track and explicit Web Audio program track; do not require OBS, a virtual camera, or tab/screen sharing to meet full-prototype acceptance. Stock-mixer output alone is an intermediate experiment.
Resolve the current event WHIP endpoint through an authorized adapter; select WHIP explicitly, never guess from RTMP/SRT/display text, and document the actual backend authorization contract.
Support the selected WHIP implementation offer/answer and ICE lifecycle, successful session resource acquisition, explicit termination and resource cleanup; verify against RFC 9725 and real ingest.
Distinguish preview-ready, transport connecting, publishing, audience-confirmed and fault states; prove outgoing media with independent receiver evidence, not an iframe load or connected label.
Handle ingestion endpoint refresh/authorization failure with bounded recovery and fresh authorization; do not retain/retry obsolete credentials indefinitely or silently switch to another event.

Start/stop publishing must not automatically start/end the platform event or bypass existing seller-consent/authorization flows; an ended event closes guest admission and tears down output after detection within 5000 ms.
A separate studio owns media across console tab changes, console reload and navigation to another event; the studio stays bound to its original event and cannot silently retarget.

Offer Document PiP from the studio top-level window on a user gesture; feature-detect it and provide a usable ordinary-window fallback when unavailable/denied. Require real supported-browser PiP evidence.
Keep the live VDO.Ninja iframe and media ownership stable across float/return; do not reparent/reload a running iframe or create a second engine/camera/publisher during a UI transition.

Closing/returning the PiP view restores controls/rendering to the studio and continues the same program within 1000 ms; the program frame producer must remain active while console interactions continue.
Handle blocked popups and studio stop/close/crash explicitly; closing PiP is not stopping output. Normal studio stop releases resources, and crash/lost-owner leases expire within 10000 ms.
Detect guest track/connection loss within 2000 ms then exclude its program media within another 1000 ms; reconnect returns to checks/backstage and requires a fresh admission.
Handle host camera/mic loss or device switching with truthful state, a placeholder/silence and actionable recovery; restore capture only with appropriate consent, without duplicate live tracks.
Bound automatic output retries to three at 1, 2 and 4 seconds (jitter up to 20%); expose a stable fault and manual retry thereafter, preserve event binding and never auto-readmit a guest.
Demonstrate actual direct and forced-TURN relay contribution paths with selected candidate-pair evidence; simulated packet loss or a configured TURN URL is not relay proof.
Support physical Android Chrome and iPhone Safari guest flows: permission grant, preflight, backstage, admission, self mute/camera and leave; emulation is not a substitute.

Handle orientation/camera switching and foreground/background/lock transitions; on observed mute/end/suspension exclude the guest within 2000 ms, and require renewed readiness/admission after interruption.
For unsupported host capabilities, missing canvas capture or blocked guest embeds, explain the limitation and offer a safe supported-browser/direct-open path; do not fake a successful fallback.

Validate origin, source window, schema version, event/session IDs, sender capability, generation, request ID and sequence before applying studio/engine commands. Reject forged, cross-event and stale messages.

Keep real host authentication, ingest tokens and publish resources out of guest payloads/URLs, DOM-visible fields, persistent browser storage, analytics and exported logs; invite capabilities are short-lived and must be redacted in shareable evidence.
Make destructive and admission commands idempotent with acknowledgement and ordering; reject commands from previous generations after removal, replacement or reconnect.

Use a documented exact-same-origin engine/media-access deployment or a verified explicit frame/audio bridge; iframe control alone and sibling subdomains do not grant parent access to video DOM/streams.
Pin the VDO.Ninja engine source/build, implementation revision and host browser versions in the build manifest/evidence; do not treat a changing alpha URL as a reproducible dependency.

Provide opt-in read-only redacted diagnostics for session/generation/program revision, admission, track counts, frame timestamps, output counters, owner/lease and fault state; no diagnostic action may bypass admission or authorization.
Make all critical controls keyboard-operable with accessible names, status announcements and predictable focus; restore focus after PiP return/error and do not announce private messages publicly.
Keep the guest journey usable at a 360x640 CSS viewport and the host console at 1280x720; avoid clipped controls, hidden buyer chat and horizontal overflow in critical controls.

Follow the target application's SSR, context, grants, exports, logging, state, localization and code-generation conventions; preserve feature-off behavior and existing host listings/chat/event controls.
Keep studio/engine messaging separate from existing commerce buses; route platform player events through the application's documented callback/command bus rather than raw top-window messages.

Dispose owned camera/mic tracks, audio contexts/nodes, render callbacks/workers, listeners/channels, peer connections and WHIP resources on final stop; component/view teardown must not dispose another owner session.

On the declared controlled desktop profile, deliver at least 25 decoded program fps for a 30 fps target, with no unplanned moving-fixture freeze over 1000 ms during normal interaction/PiP transitions.

On the defined controlled network, keep p95 A/V skew at or below 150 ms, p95 one-way conversational delay at or below 750 ms and p95 local ingest/receiver delay at or below 2000 ms; measure audience CDN delay separately.

Complete 1800 seconds of interaction/media soak with at most one program publisher, no unbounded frame queues and renderer JS heap median growth at or below 100 MiB between post-warmup and final five-minute windows.
Show the admitted guest and host-only return in actual QA buyer playback with the original event/seller/item context; record audience delay and at least two program revision transitions.

Keep a revision-bound ledger with required artifacts, measurements and every required test variant; missing, partial, failed, blocked, skipped, mock-only or stale results cannot count as full acceptance.

Run mutation/media tests only against an explicitly configured local/QA environment and prepared test event/accounts; no real purchases/bids, production publishing or public credential/artifact uploads.

Document the mobile-web guest shortcut and defer native-app integration, mobile hosting, shared selling, parallel auctions, community queues, multiple guests and operator permissions from this contract.

Deliver setup/run commands, integration decisions, pinned dependencies, validation evidence and known limitations; this review package and its tools must not modify the inspected host application checkout. Future implementation uses a separately authorized checkout.

tests.title: Console entry, popup failure and singleton launch
steps: Open a prepared eligible host event with the feature enabled.
Activate Open co-host studio twice; inspect the studio and console.
Repeat with popup creation denied and inspect recovery guidance.
expected: Listings and buyer chat remain usable.
One studio/media owner is created; second action focuses it.
Popup failure is visible and no hidden capture/publisher starts.

tests.title: Feature, authorization and event-state rejection
steps: Try the console entry and direct bootstrap URLs for each variant.
Attempt invite/publish operations at the service boundary using the denied principal or event.
Inspect network, capture indicators and event state.
expected: Both UI and trusted boundary deny the action.
Feature-off initializes no VDO.Ninja/capture/output.
Existing seller-consent and grants remain effective.

tests.title: Invite lifecycle and least privilege
steps: Create an invite for event A; inspect redacted guest bootstrap.
Attempt the variant against event B and unauthorized host actions as appropriate.
Revoke/rotate/redeem and retry the original link, including simultaneous redemption requests; for declined, explicitly decline before capture.
expected: Only one valid event-bound guest lease is issued.
Expired/revoked/redeemed capabilities cannot join anew; decline does not capture and clearly exits setup.
No host/ingest authority or secrets appear in guest data.

tests.title: Guest device checks and backstage join
steps: Use controlled fake host/guest devices in separate browser processes.
Open a freshly issued invitation, click Check devices, then Join backstage.
Read readiness and guest status in both views.
expected: Nothing captures before an explicit action.
Actual tracks and transport establish readiness.
Guest is Backstage; Bring guest on air is shown but remains disabled until output is publishing; no On air label appears yet.

tests.title: Permission and device failure recovery
steps: Begin guest setup with the selected permission/device failure.
Inspect status, available guidance and active tracks.
Correct the condition and explicitly retry.
expected: No false Ready or On air state.
A clear retry/direct-open path is available and capture resources are not leaked.
Successful retry reaches backstage once.

tests.title: Backstage media isolation at independent receiver
steps: Publish the moving red host fixture with a 440 Hz tone; join the moving blue guest fixture with an 880 Hz tone backstage.
Record an independent program receiver for at least 15 seconds after stabilization.
Analyze the interval excluding only the declared startup grace.
expected: Host video/audio are present.
Guest video/audio are absent even while host preview/private conversation works.
Receiver recording, not local UI, is the oracle.

tests.title: Private backstage text
steps: Join a guest backstage.
Send unique text from the host and a reply from the guest using Private message.
Inspect both private conversations and the visible public buyer chat region.
expected: Both private participants see the text once.
Public buyer chat does not show either message.
Labels clearly identify the private conversation.

tests.title: Admission and true public program transition
steps: Begin in the T006 state with independent recording active.
Host clicks Bring guest on air and records the command/program revision time.
Inspect guest acknowledgement and the stabilized receiver interval.
expected: Guest becomes On air only after admission acknowledgement.
Red host and blue guest plus both tones reach the real program.
Publisher/session IDs and original seller remain unchanged.

tests.title: All program layouts without republishing
steps: Admit the marked guest and keep independent recording active.
Select the required layout.
Compare fit/crop/labels, output dimensions and session/track IDs before and after.
expected: Layout matches its name and both source identities remain visible.
Output remains exactly 720x1280.
No camera reacquisition, publisher restart or duplicate audio.

tests.title: Camera/mic controls and program audio buses
steps: While on air, independently operate guest self-mute/camera and host program exclusion.
Record receiver intervals for each action; inspect caller return and local consent state.
Restore the permitted state explicitly.
expected: Mute excludes the selected public voice without doubling another voice.
Camera exclusion shows a placeholder rather than frozen guest video.
Host cannot force a guest physical capture on after local denial/mute.

tests.title: Removal and voluntary leave
steps: Admit marked guest with independent recording/timeline active.
Perform the variant.
Measure exclusion at program ingress, inspect guest state and original publisher continuity.
expected: Guest media is excluded within 1000 ms of the acknowledged command.
Original host continues without a publisher restart.
Leave stops guest capture; removal invalidates the previous admission/lease.

tests.title: Capacity, repeated joins and replacement
steps: Join one guest backstage.
Attempt the redeemed invitation from a separate browser session; trusted concurrent redemption/capacity is additionally exercised in T003.
Remove the first guest, issue a fresh invitation and join the replacement; retry the old page.
expected: Second contribution is rejected without disturbing the first.
Replacement reaches backstage after explicit removal.
Old guest cannot regain on-air status by retrying.

tests.title: Actual custom canvas/audio publishing pipeline
steps: Start publishing from our studio with marked source fixtures.
Inspect the selected output tracks and independent receiver.
Verify local preview is identified separately from delayed audience playback and no tab-share/OBS/virtual-camera dependency is used.
expected: The video source is the custom canvas and audio source is the explicit program bus.
Independent receiver contains intended media.
Capture, output bytes and receiver evidence agree.

tests.title: WHIP negotiation and session resource lifecycle
steps: Acquire event-authorized WHIP configuration.
Start and stop publishing against the selected receiver, capturing a redacted protocol summary.
Exercise response/ICE failure handling without creating duplicate sessions.
expected: Observe offer/answer, successful session acquisition and resource URL, and actual media for the real-ingest variant.
Explicit stop attempts authenticated session DELETE.
Protocol fixture success alone does not establish real ingest compatibility.

tests.title: Endpoint rotation and expired authorization
steps: Publish against prepared event endpoint A.
Rotate the event endpoint or invalidate its authorization using the test control service.
Observe the existing endpoint-update flow, fresh authorization and bounded reconnect.
expected: No indefinite obsolete endpoint/token retries.
Program remains bound to the original event; unsupported/no-WHIP configuration is a clear fault.
Fresh endpoint is used only after trusted resolution.

tests.title: Publishing versus event lifecycle
steps: Use a prepared non-production event; record event state and original Start/End controls.
Start then stop publishing from the studio.
Inspect event state and action traffic; exercise a prepared ended-event transition separately in integrated validation.
expected: Publishing start/stop alone does not start/end the seller event.
Existing event consent and start/end actions remain separate.
No purchase, bid or real commerce action is performed.

tests.title: Console navigation, reload and event binding
steps: Launch the studio and join a guest.
Switch console tabs, then reload the console.
Navigate the console to a different prepared event and inspect the original studio/session.
expected: Studio and media owner persist.
Session stays bound to event A and is never retargeted to event B.
Existing listings/chat controls remain available.

tests.title: Real Document PiP and fallback
steps: Launch a studio in the chosen host browser.
Activate Float studio from a top-level user gesture.
Exercise unavailable/denied PiP in the fallback variant.
expected: Supported browser creates an actual always-on-top Document PiP view with usable controls.
Unsupported/denied path stays usable in the ordinary studio window.
No embedded iframe attempts to invoke the API as top-level.

tests.title: PiP continuity and normal console interaction
steps: Admit moving/audio-marked guest and record an independent receiver.
Float/return ten times while using listings/chat and switching focus.
Observe engine/session/track IDs, output motion and active publisher counts.
expected: No live iframe reload/reparent, duplicate camera or session.
Program continues at acceptance frame rate without a freeze over 1000 ms.
Floating control actions affect the same program.

tests.title: PiP close is not studio stop
steps: Record the program with the guest on air in a floated view.
Close PiP through browser chrome, then repeat using Return studio.
Inspect restoration, output continuity and resource ownership.
expected: Controls/rendering restore to the ordinary studio within 1000 ms.
Original engine/publisher continue and local capture remains owned once.
Final Stop publishing remains a separate action.

tests.title: Studio stop, close and lost-owner cleanup
steps: Publish and join a guest.
Exercise explicit stop/normal close, cancel-close where browser permits, and process-crash/lost-owner lease variants.
Observe capture indicators, receiver end, session DELETE, listeners and owner expiry.
expected: Normal final stop leaves no owned capture/output resources.
Cancelled close preserves output.
Crash/lost-owner lease expires within 10000 ms; returning views cannot revive it.

tests.title: Guest loss and explicit re-admission
steps: Admit a guest and record program/timeline.
Interrupt only guest connectivity/tracks for at least three seconds.
Restore connectivity and inspect setup/backstage before trying a new admission.
expected: Loss detection plus exclusion takes at most 3000 ms.
Stale/frozen guest is replaced by host-only/placeholder output.
Recovered guest is backstage, never automatically on air.

tests.title: Host/output transport faults and bounded retries
steps: Publish against the controlled ingest.
Interrupt output connectivity or return retryable signaling errors.
Measure attempts, backoff and stable fault; explicitly request recovery.
expected: At most three automatic retries at 1/2/4 seconds plus bounded jitter.
Stable fault is actionable and truthful.
Recovery keeps event binding and guest admission safe.

tests.title: Real direct and TURN-relayed contribution
steps: Use separate host/guest network endpoints with declared ICE configuration.
Force the selected connectivity route.
Join, converse, admit and capture selected ICE candidate-pair plus real output evidence.
expected: Actual selected candidate type demonstrates the route, not just a TURN URL in configuration.
Media/admission work through the route.
Missing TURN service is BLOCKED, not a pass.

tests.title: Physical mobile guest happy path
steps: Use a physical supported phone over HTTPS and a headed desktop host.
Follow an invitation through consent, permissions, checks, backstage, admission and controls.
Leave and verify capture indicators stop; record device/browser/OS versions.
expected: All critical controls work on the actual phone.
Identity, private/on-air state and seller boundaries remain clear.
No emulation is presented as physical-device evidence.

tests.title: Mobile orientation, camera and suspension lifecycle
steps: Begin with the physical guest on air.
Rotate and switch cameras, then background/lock and foreground the guest.
Record platform mute/end/suspension events and public output.
expected: Controls remain usable through orientation/device change.
Observed suspension/mute/end gates guest media within 2000 ms.
Resume requires checks/backstage and explicit re-admission.

tests.title: Unsupported capabilities and direct-open recovery
steps: Run with the selected unsupported capability or blocked embed.
Attempt setup/publishing.
Follow the offered supported-browser/direct-open path.
expected: The limitation is explained without fake Ready/Publishing status.
No stuck camera or output session remains.
Supported recovery preserves event/session authorization.

tests.title: Message origin, schema and privilege rejection
steps: Create a valid studio session with read-only diagnostics enabled.
Send controlled malformed/cross-event/stale/untrusted-source messages into its message boundary.
Compare diagnostics and visible guest/output state before and after.
expected: All forged commands are rejected without media/program/commerce mutation.
No test-only hook bypasses trusted authorization.
Existing player commerce buses remain separate.

tests.title: Command races and generation invalidation
steps: Race admit/remove, retry a duplicate request ID and reorder acknowledgements.
Replace or reconnect the guest.
Replay old-generation admit/control messages and observe the program.
expected: Removed/replaced guest never returns on air.
Commands are idempotent and stale generations are rejected.
Acknowledgements identify the applied program revision.

tests.title: Credential isolation and redacted evidence
steps: Use distinctive synthetic host/ingest secret canaries and expired disposable invites.
Inspect guest network/DOM/storage, host persistent storage, analytics and exported logs.
Review evidence before sharing; remove/redact live capabilities.
expected: Host/ingest secrets never cross into guest/public surfaces or persistent stores.
Sensitive URLs and payloads are redacted from shareable diagnostics.
Media traces/artifacts remain in ignored private output directories.

tests.title: Keyboard, focus and assistive presentation
steps: Complete the critical host/guest flow with keyboard only.
Float/return/close PiP and trigger a recoverable error.
Inspect names, focus order, status announcements and private-message presentation with assistive tooling.
expected: Every critical control is reachable/operable and focus returns predictably.
State is not conveyed by color alone.
Private messages are not announced into public chat.

tests.title: Critical viewport layouts
steps: At 1280x720 inspect console listings/public chat/co-host entry and studio controls.
At 360x640 inspect the guest setup/backstage/on-air controls.
Traverse visible controls and inspect horizontal overflow.
expected: Critical controls are visible, usable and not clipped.
Guest viewport has no horizontal document overflow.
Host co-host entry does not obscure listings or buyer chat.

tests.title: Host camera/microphone loss and switch
steps: Publish while the guest is admitted.
Remove/switch the selected host input or deny its renewed permission.
Observe program placeholder/silence, error recovery and active track counts.
expected: State reflects actual device availability; no frozen success state.
Retry/switch is explicit and restores only permitted capture.
No duplicated host tracks/audio.

tests.title: Thirty-minute media and interaction soak
steps: Use the declared desktop hardware/browser and moving source fixtures; record continuous receiver output and samples.
Warm up five minutes, then exercise chat/listings/layouts/float/return during a total run of at least 1800 seconds.
Compare post-warmup and final five-minute median renderer heap; inspect source motion and queues.
expected: At least 25 decoded fps and no unplanned source-motion freeze over 1000 ms under normal operation.
At most one publisher and bounded frame queues.
JS heap median growth is no more than 100 MiB.

tests.title: A/V alignment, conversational delay and echo
steps: Use synchronized visible flash/audio-pulse fixtures and a declared controlled network of at most 20 ms added RTT and no induced loss.
Collect at least 30 observations of call and local-program timing.
Exercise headphones and normal speaker echo cancellation; record audience delay separately.
expected: p95 A/V skew <=150 ms, one-way call delay <=750 ms and local-program receiver delay <=2000 ms.
No sustained self-return/doubled voice; no delayed buyer audio in the call.
Wall clocks/timelines are synchronized or uncertainty is bounded and reported.

tests.title: Integrated QA buyer program and commerce context
steps: Use an explicitly authorized prepared QA event and original seller/item; start event only through existing consent/controls if needed.
Observe actual buyer playback while admitting/removing guest and changing layouts.
Send unique private host/guest messages; inspect a separate buyer session and its chat/network traffic throughout a declared observation window.
End the prepared event through its existing control and observe studio teardown.
expected: At least two program revisions reach the real buyer with the original event/seller/item.
Neither private message reaches buyer chat, buyer message payloads or program overlays; console-only absence is insufficient.
Publishing and event lifecycle stay distinct; no bid/purchase is executed.
Ended event denies new admission and tears down output within 5000 ms of detection.

tests.title: Current host application regression and integration conventions
steps: Review the implementation diff against the pinned current integration map and current contributor/testing/messaging guides.
Exercise feature-off host console and enabled listing/chat/consent/event controls; run appropriate existing build/type/i18n/generated-file checks in the implementation checkout.
Inspect SSR and messaging integration; record pre-existing failures separately.
expected: Feature-off behavior and existing seller workflows are preserved.
Context/grants, English i18n/codegen, logger and browser/server boundaries are respected.
Historical experiment code is not blindly restored over current source.

tests.title: Pinned engine, origin policy and deployment feasibility
steps: Record implementation/engine revisions and actual served origins/headers.
Verify the selected same-origin media-access or explicit frame/audio bridge path.
Exercise camera/mic iframe delegation and custom-canvas output without screen sharing.
expected: Origin/policy assumptions are demonstrated in the actual deployment.
Alpha/release source is pinned or vendored, not an unversioned moving dependency.
Browser/canvas support is truthful and no cross-origin DOM access is assumed.

tests.title: Independent evidence and truthful diagnostics
steps: Compare application diagnostics with output network counters and independent receiver/buyer artifacts.
Confirm telemetry has no mutating acceptance backdoor or fabricated success counter.
Check timestamps, generation and program revisions across evidence.
expected: Preview, call transport, program output and audience confirmation are separately proven.
Read-only telemetry agrees with independent observations.
Missing dependencies/results remain blocked or not_run.

tests.title: Reproducible handoff and unchanged review checkout
steps: Inspect setup commands, decisions, contract traceability and all required case variants.
Compare the source snapshot with its review baseline, explicitly reporting scope/unreadable files.
Confirm future implementation is isolated and completion claims match evidence.
expected: No edits were made to the inspected host application source by this review package.
Commands and dependencies are reproducible.
Mobile-web scope and deferred features are documented; no skipped/missing result is promoted to accepted.

provenance: Public live-collaboration exploration, VDO.Ninja/browser references, and proposed prototype defaults. No private source revision or deployment API is distributed. See integration-map.md and review-findings.md. Not approved production SLAs.
